parents.tactic: K1-canonical: coins in given (unsorted) order; plain list; no filtering
K1-sorted-asc: sorted(coins) then canonical loop
K1-sparse-dict: dp as dict keyed by amount, .get defaults; ascending amount pass
K1-filtered-while: coins filtered to c <= amount preserving given order; while-loop updates; early return 1 when amount == 0
K1-sorted-desc: coins sorted descending, canonical ascending-amount update
K1-double-buffer: per coin, cur = prev.copy(); cur[a] += cur[a - c] ascending; swap
K1-bisect-cutoff: coins sorted ascending; bisect_right locates prefix <= A; loop over prefix only
K2-full-table: list-of-lists, rows i = 0..n, row-wise fill
K2-rolling-rows: two rows prev/cur, cur[a] = prev[a] + cur[a - c_i], swap per coin
K2-column-major: amount-outer (a ascending), index-inner fill on the full table
K2-suffix-indexed: coins reversed (descending); suffix table filled i descending; output T[0][A]
K2-dict-rows: per-index rows as sparse dicts with .get defaults
K2-flat-stride: single flat list of (n+1)(A+1) cells, manual stride i*(A+1)+a
K2-row-builder: per coin, cur = prev[:] then in-row ascending extension cur[a] += cur[a - c_i] from a = c_i
K2-skip-compression: coins sorted ascending; coins > A contribute identity rows (row copied forward)
K3-lru-usefirst: functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None); branch order (use, skip); coins as given
K3-dict-skipfirst: explicit dict memo; branch order (skip, use); coins as given
K3-explicit-stack: iterative post-order DFS with explicit frames; no Python recursion
K3-flat-memo: memo as flat list of size (n+1)(A+1) initialized to sentinel -1; coins sorted ascending
K3-desc-largestfirst: coins sorted descending; suffix recursion largest-part-first; lru_cache; branch (use, skip)
K3-asc-smallestfirst: coins sorted ascending; suffix recursion; dict memo; branch (skip, use)
K3-bisect-prune: coins sorted ascending; bisect_left advances i past all coins > a; dict memo
K3-lru-asc-bounded: coins sorted ascending; lru_cache; branch (use, skip); recursion limit set from explicit depth derivation
K4-doubling: geometric doubling schedule 1, coins as given
K4-doubling-desc: schedule 1, coins sorted descending, c > A skipped
K4-residue-chains: schedule 2, coins as given
K4-residue-chains-sorted: schedule 2, coins sorted ascending, c > A filtered
K4-doubling-sparse: schedule 3 (dict carrier)
K5-split-given: split by given-order index (first ceil(n/2) vs. rest)
K5-split-sorted: split after sorting ascending (small/large halves)
